item.address: 47-49 Neerim Road, Castle Cove NSW 2069, NSW 2069
item.description:
***   OPEN WEDNESDAY 22ND JULY, 11.00AM - 11.30AM   ***

Commanding an extraordinary waterfront reserve landholding across two addresses, this vast residence is one of the North Shore's most iconic homes, conceived on a monumental scale for grand family living. Designed by Swiss-trained architect Gerry Rihs, the home unfolds across three lift-connected levels, where a soaring marble-lined foyer crowned by a stained-glass dome sets an unforgettable tone. Walls of glazing draw in northeasterly light and sweeping Middle Harbour views, while a sequence of formal and informal living spaces, palatial bedroom suites and resort-style leisure zones create a home of architectural confidence and unmistakable prestige. Manicured grounds, an infinity pool, pickleball court, home theatre, wellness facilities and extensive entertaining terraces reinforce the sense of private retreat, while the setting remains just moments from the convenience and vibrance of Chatswood's retail and dining precincts.

*Landmark waterfront reserve residence across two merged addresses
* Architect-designed by Swiss-trained Gerry Rihs on a grand scale
* Sweeping northeasterly views across Middle Harbour and Bantry Bay
* Three expansive lift-connected levels, lavish contemporary finishes
* Grand marble foyer beneath a soaring stained-glass dome ceiling
* Multiple formal and informal living spaces with harbour outlooks
* Stone cocktail bar, sitting room overlooking the pickleball court
* Gaggenau kitchen with gas and electric cooking, butler's pantry
* Seven bedrooms, six with ensuites, including self-contained apartment
* Palatial main suite with sitting area, dressing room and harbour terrace
* Luxe master ensuite with dual showers, freestanding bath, dual vanity
* Home theatre with seven reclining seats and separate games retreat
* Entertainer's terrace with barbecues, teppanyaki grill and pizza oven
* Infinity pool suspended against breathtaking Middle Harbour views
* Putting green, meticulously landscaped grounds with water features
* Gym with views, Swedish sauna, massage room and lavish bathroom 
* Four-car garage, gated forecourt parking and extensive storage rooms
* Keyless entry, video intercom, ducted air-con and underfloor heating
* Prestigious harbourside setting moments from Chatswood's dining hub
